Generated Narrative: CodeSystem diagnostic-report-status-reason

This case-sensitive code system http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/diagnostic-report-status-reason defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
patient-mismatch Patient MismatchThe patient identity or subject context did not match the expected patient or subject.
sample-mismatch Sample MismatchThe specimen, sample, or referenced result did not match the expected subject, order, container, or report.
invalid-calibration Invalid CalibrationThe device, instrument, or analyzer calibration used for referenced results was invalid, expired, or otherwise unreliable.
reagent-issue Reagent issueAn incorrect, invalid, expired, recalled, or otherwise unsuitable reagent or reagent lot was used or identified for referenced results.
duplicate DuplicateThe diagnostic report duplicates another diagnostic report.

name: DiagnosticReportStatusReasonCodes
title: Diagnostic Report Status Reason Codes
description: Codes indicating why a diagnostic report is in its current status.

concept.definition: The patient identity or subject context did not match the expected patient or subject.

An incorrect, invalid, expired, recalled, or otherwise unsuitable reagent or reagent lot was used or identified for referenced results.
The diagnostic report duplicates another diagnostic report.
